L1: REWORK
Head-sha: 48c66567ecf8b90f1e67ce9b2f4b8fc44e17834c

Read at this head:
- the full diff (40 files, +1201 −151) against merge-base dfbc316d;
- claim 6943341819 and amendments 6943390470, 6944389276 and 6945284693;
- the changeset;
- every log, plus `check.mjs` and the zh shots, in `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat3/34725-live/`.

The head merges cleanly with main 25d3d85c. `check-governed-merges` reads 1352 lines, not governed. `Fixes #34725` is right.

The shape is right:
- **Claim surface:** every changed file is inside it.
- **Changeset:** it names `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/i18n`, the two published packages whose src moved. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private, and listing it does no harm.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: yes (widening …)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` match amendment 6943390470. The seat's L2 at TIER_DEFAULT covers the `GridFieldAuthoring.columnMarks` face.
- **Strings:** the new studio keys exist in both `namespaces/studio/en.ts` and `zh.ts` (the namespace has no other packs). The changed eager values (`console.ai.discussing`, `draftedByCopilot`) are in all 11 packs. The `ar` waiver follows the ratchet's documented route.
- **Readings already in hand:** at 1163 wide, in zh and en, the live readings cover:
  - the name;
  - the robot as the top bar's last control, and its toggle;
  - the 44 px single header row with History, widen and Close;
  - widen keeping the URL;
  - 420 → 520 px with the width stored across a reload;
  - the chip 「正在看：任务 · 记录」 / 「· 表单」;
  - the container-query fix (header `scrollWidth == clientWidth` at both widths).

## Must-fix

**M1. Live readings are missing for two of the card's acceptance points, plus the header's switch.** `check.mjs` never touches the canvas marks, the line or the ask-data table. In the shots, the open object (`showcase_task`) is read-only, so no draft could appear there. Please add readings in zh-CN and en at 1163 wide, on an editable object that has an AI-tool draft (`by: 'copilot'`) pending:
1. **Acceptance 4.**
   - The line 「AI 刚改了 1 处」 / "The AI assistant just made 1 change" over the canvas.
   - The 草稿 chip on the changed field's Form card. For a changed published field, also on its records-grid column header (`studio-grid-column-draft-chip`). The added-field column deviation is accepted and stated.
   - 查看 opens the pending-changes sheet in review.
   - 放弃全部未发布改动: the confirm appears, and after OK the line and the chips are gone.
2. **Acceptance 2.** An ask-data answer with a 3-column table, at the 420 px default, shows no horizontal clipping.
3. **Item 3's left half.** In the reading, `header tabs: []` shows the title only, because the Data pillar had no properties half. Please read the header once with a field selected, so 属性 | AI 助手 and History / widen / Close all sit in the one 44 px row.

Also name the head the readings were taken on. The files are timestamped 10:35, which is right after a1521d1a. Every code change after that is #34713's (already landed) or test-only, so the existing readings stand.

## Should-fix

- **S1.** `discardFailed` is filled with `${f.type}/${f.name}: ${f.error}`. That puts machine names and the server's raw (English) error into the zh line. Prefer each item's label, falling back to its name, and keep the raw error out of the sentence, or behind a detail.

## Notes

- `useStudioSlotWidth` clamps against `window.innerWidth` only on render or drag. A window shrunk afterwards keeps the stored width until the next render. The canvas floor still applies at the next interaction, so this is not a blocker.
- Eager budget: i18n-locale-en reads 61,823 B, 177 B of headroom, on main dfbc316d. #34850 (open) adds an eager key it measured at +26 B on an older base. Whichever of the two lands second needs a green `Build & E2E UI` (`check:eager-closure`) on its own merge ref.
- Items 4 and 8 (widen in place, no Publish on result cards) rest on #34713's ACCEPTed readings. I have not re-read them here.
- `engine.studio.slot.openFullPage` is now unread. It is recorded as out of scope, and its retirement is a separate change, as the report says.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `48c66567ecf8b90f1e67ce9b2f4b8fc44e17834c`
Local-runs: none

The face, read off the committed tree rather than any statement about it: none of the 40 paths falls under the suspect glob (`packages/spec/src/**`) or a governed-register row (`ui/scripts/**` is not one). The changeset and the PR body both carry `Clause-②: yes (widening — …)`, which reads arm `widening` with no narrowing. That is the declaration face at `TIER_DEFAULT`, and it carries no ④.

Inputs: card #34725 (body and all 6 comments: triage 6943276975, claim 6943341819, amendments 6943390470 / 6944389276 / 6945284693, os-dev report 6949916351); the PR #34851 body, its 40-file list and the net diff against merge-base `dfbc316dfe` (+1201 / −151); and the check-runs on the head (58 runs, all completed by 14:07Z: 45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failure. They include Type Check UI, Lint UI, Test UI 1–16, Build & E2E UI, Check Changeset and the Governed Surface Queue Guard. `UI Published Artifacts` is skipped because its `if:` excludes `pull_request` events, which is expected).

### ① Derived judgments

Public-surface changes the diff implies:

1. **`@object-ui/components` `GridFieldAuthoring.columnMarks`** (an optional, read-only Record from accessorKey string to `React.ReactNode`) (`ui/packages/components/src/context/gridFieldAuthoring.tsx`; the type is exported from `src/index.ts:167`; the package is not private). **Right.**
   - *Optional:* `?:`, and no default changes.
   - *Backward compatible:* the interface only gains a member. Every existing object literal still type-checks, and a reader of `useGridFieldAuthoring()` sees one more optional field.
   - *Documented:* the jsdoc names the key (accessorKey = field name), says a column with no entry draws nothing, gives "Omit for no marks", and names the first consumer. The changeset body states it as well.
   - *Existing callers are unaffected:* the one render site is `data-table.tsx:3564`, `{fieldAuthoring?.columnMarks?.[col.accessorKey]}`, after the header label. With no provider, `fieldAuthoring` is `null` and the line renders `undefined`, so runtime tables stay byte-identical, as the module docblock promises. With a provider and no `columnMarks` it also renders `undefined`. The only in-tree provider is the Studio Data pillar, and it spreads `columnMarks` in only when the set is non-empty. The pin `data-table-columnMarks-34725.test.tsx` covers a marked column, an unmarked column and the no-provider case.
2. **`@object-ui/i18n/namespaces/studio`: 8 new keys** (`engine.studio.slot.history`, `engine.studio.slot.resize`, `engine.studio.copilotChanges.{lineOne,line,view,discardAll,discardConfirm,discardFailed}`), each in both `en` and `zh`. This is a widening of the published catalogue. **Right.**
3. **Value changes, no key added or removed:**
   - `engine.studio.aiCopilot` and `engine.studio.draftMark.agent.copilot` (studio namespace);
   - `console.ai.discussing`, changed in all 11 eager packs;
   - `preview.changes.draftedByCopilot`, changed in en and the 9 non-ar packs, with ar waived in `i18n-en-drift-baseline.json` and `WAIVER_CEILING` 6 → 7 plus its history line.

   A changed string is not an accept-set or type change: `TranslationKeys` is unchanged, and no in-tree test pins the old text (the `'AI copilot'` in `ChatDock.test.tsx:154` is that test's own `title` fixture). **Right.**
4. **`engine.studio.slot.openFullPage` is now unread but kept.** Removing a key from a published catalogue would be a narrowing, so keeping it here and retiring it separately is the correct call. **Right.**
5. **Workspace-private, not a published surface.** `@object-ui/app-shell` is `"private": true`. Its changes are `ChatPane.hideHeader` (default `false`, so other hosts are unchanged), `ObjectFormDesigner.draftMarkedFields`, the `DataPillar` props `onSurfaceLabelChange` and `onReviewChanges`, the `STUDIO_SLOT_WIDTH` export (removed, with no remaining reference in `ui/`), and the new `localStorage` key `studio-right-slot-width`. That key is per-browser UI state, and a bad stored value falls back to 420. **Right.**
6. **Accept sets:** none. No spec, metadata, server or API path is touched, and no persisted metadata shape changes. **Right** (none implied, none needed).

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/34725-studio-ai-assistant-panel.md` declares `patch` for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/i18n`. Under the AGENTS.md rule, `Metadata-protocol: none` ships `patch`, and a non-protocol widening is still `patch`. The package set matches the packages the diff moves. **Right.**

Clause-②: yes (widening) — confirmed. The PR body and changeset carry identical line-initial declarations, and the arm reads `widening` (the `— …` gloss inside the parenthesis is the tolerated form). Both widenings are real (① 1 and ① 2), and nothing is narrowed. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: nothing a metadata author writes changes.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`:** `[]` in report 6949916351. Nothing to answer.
- **Dev flag: the item 7 / acceptance 4 deviation.** A field the assistant *adds* has no grid column until it is published (cloud#1652), so its mark falls on its Form card and the count line instead of a column header. The card's acceptance 4 literally asks for "the new column carries the draft mark". The PR body and report say "the seat accepted this deviation; no follow-up card", but no comment on card #34725 records that acceptance. This is not a contract question: the code marks what the grid can show, from the same `draftChanges` read. **Escalated:** the seat should record its acceptance on the card thread (or take it to the maintainer, who set the acceptance) before landing, so that a closed card does not appear to meet acceptance 4 as written.
- **Dev flag: `engine.studio.slot.openFullPage` is now dead** (out_of_scope_findings). **Answered:** see ① 4. It belongs in a separate retirement and is not a blocker.
- **Brief question: i18n-locale-en at 61,823 B of 62,000 — could the added keys be lazier?** **No; they already are as lazy as they can be.** All 8 new keys are in the studio namespace, a separate subpath that is not part of the `i18n-locale-en` eager chunk. The eager `en.ts` diff is +2 / −2 and changes values only: `Discussing:` → `Viewing:` is −3 chars, and `copilot` → `assistant` is +2. The dev's reading of 61,823 B against #34713's 61,824 B is consistent with that. The two eager keys whose values changed already lived in the eager pack, and the card (item 6) wants one wording on both surfaces. Moving them out would be a key move outside this card. Headroom stays at 177 B, so the next eager addition is where the budget has to be paid.
- **SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5):** no finding. The diff adds no server read, query, id materialisation or join. The canvas marks and the count are derived client-side from the open object's existing `draftChanges` read (no new fetch), and the discard is the existing `packages.discardDrafts(packageId)` door.
- **Nits** (none affects correctness or the contract):
  - N1. The `columnMarks` lookup reads inherited members. In both `data-table.tsx:3564` and the host's `{}` literal, a field name the spec admits (`^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$`), such as `constructor`, reads `Object.prototype` members once any mark exists. `constructor` renders nothing and logs a dev warning, and a marked `__proto__` would re-point the map's prototype. Guard the published read with `Object.hasOwn(columnMarks, col.accessorKey)`, or build the host map with `Object.create(null)`.
  - N2. `useStudioSlotWidth` (`studioRightSlotState.ts`) re-implements the pointer drag and width persistence of `useChatDockState`, which already takes `persistWidthKey`. It shares that hook's lack of `pointercancel` handling and unmount cleanup mid-drag. A shared helper would keep the two drawers from drifting.
  - N3. Docblocks in `StudioDraftMark.tsx` (lines 6, 121–122) still quote 「AI 副驾」. These are comments, not shipped strings.
  - N4. The PR body says `draftedByCopilot` changed in "en and eight packs". The diff and the drift-ledger history line both show en plus nine (de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant).
